s_e7373.text_1: Mimic and bionic creatures drop no items when killed, but split into living Slimes
s_e7373.text_2: Trading with mimic villagers only yields Slimeballs as well
s_e7373.text_3: Apply Regeneration to a mimic creature...
s_e7373.text_4: Then use an Encased Fan and Soul Campfire to haunt it
s_e7373.text_5: This transforms the mimic creature into a normal mob
s_e7373.title: Haunting Mimic Creatures
scene_1.text_1: Slime Petri Dishes can be used to cultivate mimic creatures
scene_1.text_2: Insert a Living Mechanism into the Petri Dish...
scene_1.text_3: Then pipe in Liquid Living Slime...
scene_1.text_4: The Liquid Living Slime mimics a nearby mob and grows
scene_1.text_5: Mobs with more maximum health require more Liquid Living Slime to mimic
scene_1.title: Cultivating Mimic Creatures
title: Cultivating Mimic Creatures
